method: Iterative build-error resolution + real-browser-journey root-cause tracing: every file/table/route pulled onto the integration branch was pulled because a genuine, reproduced runtime failure (module-resolution error, 404, 500, or a stalled canonical-journey checkpoint) named it, never speculatively.

REQUIRED_FRONTEND: All src/pages/smokecraft/*.jsx screens on the canonical 27-session spine plus their supporting-module siblings (Connections, SecondHumidorMatch, MiniTasting, SmokeCraftChallenge)

src/constants/smokecraft*.js (loyalty, landing actions/cta, navigation registry, live-screen tokens, journey status, screen manifest, component registry, interaction manifest, entry readiness, educational enrichment, assetVersion)

src/data/*.js referenced by the tested screens (leafChallengeRounds, knowledgeCheckQuestions, cultivationStages, venueInventoryData, loyaltyPointRulesClient, smokeCraftVenueCommerce, smokeCraftInventorySeed, smokeCraftTicketTapperSpecials)
src/services/smokecraft/*.js API clients actually called by a tested screen (assetResolver, pairingEngineApiClient, playerStateApiClient, and siblings)
src/services/{sessionStorageService,passportService,passportAdapter}.js — swapped for recovery's versions because main's own lacked exports GuestSessionContext/VisitLockGuard require
src/lib/stripeClient.js (transitively required by an import chain; only reads an env var, never imports @stripe/stripe-js)
public/assets/smokecraft/** — 62 image files restored after Block-8 self-QA found FlavorMemory.jsx rendering a broken image (raw alt text visible)
SHARED_REQUIRED_BACKEND: server/routes/{pos360SmokeCraftOrderBridgeRoutes,eatSmokeCraftLiveSyncRoutes,managementSyncRoutes,smokecraftTicketTapperSpecialsRoutes,smokecraftVenueCommerceRoutes,smokecraftPlayerStateRoutes,pairingEngineRoutes}.js — mounted at distinct base paths alongside main's existing /api/smokecraft and /api/eat/smokecraft mounts, no collision

server/controllers + server/services/smokecraft/* transitive chain for the above (playerStateService, selectionClassificationService, tastingObservationService, scorecardEvaluationService, pairingEngineService, progressionEventService, skillTreeService, sessionRewardTable, passport360SyncService, passport360SmokeCraftPersistenceService)

server/db/migrations/015-041 (24 migrations renumbered from recovery's 017/038/068-070/074/079/092-105/119-121 to sit after main's real tail at 014, plus two newly authored: 039_smokecraft_venue_registry.sql and 041_smokecraft_progression_events.sql, and one extraction: 040_smokecraft_pairing_flavor_memory.sql)
ALREADY_ON_MAIN: server/middleware/{smokecraftGuestIdentity,roleMiddleware,authMiddleware}.js — main's own real, JWT-cookie-based identity system, reused verbatim, no second identity scheme invented

Main's own smoke_*-prefixed and smokecraft_activity_attempts/player_state/session_completions/tasting_drafts tables (verified via psql \dt before pulling any migration that referenced them — confirmed non-colliding naming convention vs recovery's pos360_*/eat_smokecraft_*/smokecraft_management_sync_* tables)
MAIN_UNIQUE_TO_PRESERVE: None found that could be integrated without weakening Blocks 1-7 or introducing a second architecture. Main's pre-existing SmokeCraft screens (Identity.jsx, PassportStamp.jsx, parts of Format.jsx) used the forbidden screenshot-hotspot architecture (SmokeCraftAssetRoute + invisible % positioned hotspots over a baked PNG) and were superseded wholesale by recovery's live-DOM equivalents per the mandate's explicit instruction not to reintroduce that pattern.
UNRELATED_EXCLUDED: The full VenueHumidor commerce/admin/payment subsystem (src/pages/smokecraft/venueHumidor/**, checkout, admin dashboard) — deliberately excluded from App.jsx's route tree because it would have required adding an untested @stripe/stripe-js dependency and sits outside the tested canonical journey. Files remain present but unrouted (harmless dead code, not deleted, so a future integration pass can wire them in deliberately).
helmet, sharp (initially), @aws-sdk/client-s3, @dnd-kit/core, @dnd-kit/utilities, stripe — none actually imported by any required runtime code path
OBSOLETE_SUPERSEDED: Main's original /api/smokecraft and /api/eat/smokecraft route handlers backing the old screenshot-hotspot screens remain mounted (harmless, unreferenced by the live-DOM screens) rather than deleted, per the additive-integration mandate — not removed, just no longer the active code path for any migrated screen.
